question: I recently read in a security blog: "Successful exploitation enables threat actors to execute arbitrary malicious code on devices running vulnerable iOS, macOS, and tvOS versions after opening a malicious web page." and "processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution." Please provide: 1) which MITRE ATT&CK category maps to this behavior, 2) an explanation of how this behavior maps to the technique, and 3) what are the data sources (telemetry/logs) specified in the MITRE ATT&CK entry?
answer: 1) MITRE ATT&CK Category: Exploitation for Client Execution (T1658). 2) Explanation: The behavior described in the blog—where opening or processing malicious web content triggers arbitrary code execution on vulnerable devices—is a clear instance of exploiting a software vulnerability in client-located components, which aligns with the defined technique T1658. 3) Data Sources: The MITRE entry does not specify any particular data sources (x_mitre_data_sources is null).
